name: volume-high
useCase: Indicate a high audio volume level beside a volume control.
misuse: Do not use two sound waves as a precise numerical volume value.

16.reason: A compact speaker retains the family’s 45-degree cone edges and shares its base with volume-x. Two separately drawn waves have at least 1px of space.

24.reason: The compact speaker shares volume-x geometry and retains the family’s cone angles; the two longer waves keep at least 1.5px of space. The outer arc stays within the 3px inset.
